Test Pages › Failure Analysis › Incorrect Sort Behavior
Type A: App Bug

Incorrect Sort Behavior

A sortable list where the "Sort A-Z" button incorrectly sorts items in reverse alphabetical order (Z-A) instead of A-Z.

Fruit List

Click "Sort A-Z" to sort the list alphabetically. The items should appear in alphabetical order from A to Z.

Unsorted

Expected Behavior

After clicking "Sort A-Z", the list should display items in alphabetical order: Apple, Banana, Cherry, Date, Elderberry.
